```c
/*******************************************************************************

*
* Instrument: RTP_DIF (Powder Diffractometer)
*
* %Identification
* Written by: McStas Instrument Design
* Date: 2024
* Origin: Risø DTU
* Version: 1.0
*
* %INSTRUMENT_SITE: Risø
*
* %Description
* Powder diffractometer with curved monochromator and position-sensitive detectors.
*
* %Parameters
* lambda: [Angstrom] Neutron wavelength (default 2.36)
* DM: [Angstrom] d-spacing of monochromator (default 3.355)
* Mono_tilt: [deg] Monochromator tilt angle (default 0)
* powder: [str] Powder reflection file (default "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz")
* det_rotation: [deg] Detector rotation angle (default 45)
*
* %End
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT RTP_DIF(
    lambda = 2.36,
    DM = 3.355,
    Mono_tilt = 0,
    string powder = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz",
    det_rotation = 45
)

DECLARE
%{
  double mono_takeoff_angle;
  int mono_index = 0;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  mono_takeoff_angle = 2.0 * asin(lambda / 2.0 / DM) * RAD2DEG;
  printf("RTP_DIF: Monochromator take-off angle=%g [deg]\n", mono_takeoff_angle);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar(
    profile=1)
AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT source = Source_gen(
    radius = 0.154/2,
    dist = 1.16 + 1.50,
    focus_xw = 0.11,
    focus_yh = 0.03,
    lambda0 = lambda,
    dlambda = 0.2,
    I1 = 2.79e12/4/M_PI,
    T1 = 300)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT CoarseCollimator1 = Guide(
    w1 = 0.154,
    h1 = 0.154,
    l = 1.16125,
    m = 0)
AT (0, 0, 0.01) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT CoarseCollimator2 = Guide(
    w1 = 0.11,
    h1 = 0.11,
    l = 1.5,
    m = 0)
AT (0, 0, 1.16125 + 0.003) RELATIVE CoarseCollimator1

COMPONENT lmon = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.11,
    yheight = 0.11,
    bins = 50,
    options = "slit disk, auto wavelength",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 1.5 + 0.01) RELATIVE CoarseCollimator2

COMPONENT Be_Position = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0.147 + 0.15/2) RELATIVE lmon

COMPONENT mono_cradle = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0.145 + 0.15/2 + 0.176) RELATIVE Be_Position
SPLIT 10

COMPONENT mono_rotation = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
ROTATED (0, -asin(lambda/2.0/DM)*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
EXTEND
%{
  mono_index = 0;
%}

COMPONENT mono1 = Monochromator_curved(
    reflect = "HOPG.rfl",
    transmit = "HOPG.trm",
    NH = 1,
    NV = 1,
    mosaich = 48,
    mosaicv = 48,
    RV = 0,
    RH = 0,
    DM = DM,
    width = 0.11,
    height = 0.03)
AT (-0.01, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
ROTATED (0, Mono_tilt, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
EXTEND
%{
  if (SCATTERED) mono_index = 1;
%}

COMPONENT mono2 = Monochromator_curved(
    reflect = "HOPG.rfl",
    transmit = "HOPG.trm",
    NH = 1,
    NV = 1,
    mosaich = 48,
    mosaicv = 48,
    RV = 0,
    RH = 0,
    DM = DM,
    width = 0.11,
    height = 0.03)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
EXTEND
%{
  if (SCATTERED) mono_index = 2;
%}

COMPONENT mono3 = Monochromator_curved(
    reflect = "HOPG.rfl",
    transmit = "HOPG.trm",
    NH = 1,
    NV = 1,
    mosaich = 48,
    mosaicv = 48,
    RV = 0,
    RH = 0,
    DM = DM,
    width = 0.11,
    height = 0.03)
AT (0.01, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
ROTATED (0, -Mono_tilt, 0) RELATIVE mono_rotation
EXTEND
%{
  if (SCATTERED) mono_index = 3;
%}

COMPONENT mono_takeoff = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle
ROTATED (0, -2.0*asin(lambda/2.0/DM)*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT psd_transmit = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.12,
    yheight = 0.12,
    bins = 50,
    options = "x y",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.25) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT psd_reflect = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.12,
    yheight = 0.12,
    bins = 50,
    options = "x y",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.574) RELATIVE mono_takeoff

COMPONENT sample_psd = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.02,
    yheight = 0.02,
    bins = 50,
    options = "disk slit, x y",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.575 + 0.50) RELATIVE mono_takeoff

COMPONENT sample_position = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0.575 + 0.5 + 0.01) RELATIVE mono_takeoff
SPLIT 100

COMPONENT container_in = PowderN(
    reflections = "V.lau",
    radius = 0.01/2,
    yheight = 0.04,
    thickness = -50e-6,
    p_transmit = 0.95,
    d_phi = 50,
    concentric = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position

COMPONENT sample = PowderN(
    reflections = powder,
    radius = 0.01/2,
    yheight = 0.04,
    d_phi = atan2(0.5, 1.0)*RAD2DEG)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position
EXTEND
%{
  if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB;
%}

COMPONENT container_out = PowderN(
    reflections = "V.lau",
    radius = 0.01/2,
    yheight = 0.04,
    thickness = -50e-6,
    p_transmit = 0.95,
    d_phi = 50,
    concentric = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position

COMPONENT sample_out = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position
ROTATED (0, det_rotation, 0) RELATIVE sample_position

COMPONENT det_big = Monitor_nD(
    yheight = 0.5,
    radius = 1,
    options = "banana theta limits=[-150 150] bins=300, y bins=64",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample_position

COMPONENT det = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.5,
    yheight = 0.0254,
    bins = 25,
    options = "x",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 1) RELATIVE sample_out

COMPONENT reactor = Shape(
    type = "cylinder",
    radius = 0.7/2,
    yheight = 0.4)
AT (0, 0, -0.35) RELATIVE Origin

END
```
